faqs.question: What is the most important feature in an air purifier?
faqs.answer: A high-efficiency True HEPA filter combined with sufficient airflow (CADR) for your room size is the most critical factor for particle removal.

faqs.question: How often should I replace air purifier filters?
faqs.answer: Most manufacturers recommend replacing HEPA filters every 6 to 12 months, while washable pre-filters should be cleaned monthly.
